fields.why: Four race/ethnicity groups are compared within income levels with significance statements, and three ordered FPL levels within White adults.
Race/ethnicity (4 groups) and family income as % FPL (3 ordered levels) are the two SPDs with 3+ groups compared.

At 100%–199% and ≥200% FPL only 4 of 6 race pairs are stated (Hispanic/Black vs Asian/White), and income steps are adjacent-level tests, so per-group vs referent fits. At <100% FPL every pair is addressed (Hispanic/Black/White not significant, 'but' each lower than Asian), so adding 'pairwise (all pairs)' is also defensible.

brief_issues: Rule 7 counts SPD groups within one level of a cross-classifier, but the brief does not say how to record one groupwise entry when strata differ in pair coverage (all pairs at one income level, some pairs at others), nor whether 'lower' following a significance clause counts as a stated pair.
